story.title: Friendship
paragraphs_en: Children story-----Friendship wins! Om parkash Kshatriya 'Parkash There lived a Gilloo squirrel. Chinoo ant also lived there. Both were fast friends.
On seeing Gilloo, ollo owl came near her.
" Will you like to roam around sky?", Ollo said to Gilloo.
Gilloo never roamed around the sky. She said, 'I do not know how to fly? How can i roam around?'
" It is very easy." Ollo said.?" You just sit on my back. I will fly around ." " Yes! It will be alright." Gilloo said. Gilloo sat on the back of Ollo.
Ollo flew high in the sky. Ollo clenched tightly Gilloo in his paws. " Arre!What are you doing?, Gilloo said, " I will die if I get loosened from your paws".
Ollo at once landed on the tree and said, " You have to die otherwise too. I brought you here only to kill". Saying this, Ollo laughed loudly.
At that very moment, Chinoo came. He gave a severe bite at Ollo paws. Ollo got hurt. He screamed at once. His grip got loose. Gilloo set free. She ran fast. But Ollo caught her by its tail.
" Where do you run like this?", thundered Ollo. Chinnoo at once gave another bite to his paws. Gilloo set free and fell down on earth. Chinnoo too jumped down.
Gilloo got up hurriedly. She shaked her body and ran fast. Chinnoo climbed on her back. Gilloo said," How could you reach on the tree?Ollo would have killed me if you were not on time".

Chinnoo told, " When you sat on the back of Ollo, I was also tempted to roam around the sky. I too clinged myself on its tail" "Oh! That is why you were also on the tree. " Gilloo was happy. She said, " You saved my life".
Chinnoo said with proud, " At last, A friend in need is a friend indeed." Both went towards their homes.
